newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Teva gets FDA generic drug approval.
newsitem.headline: Teva gets FDA generic drug approval.

text.p: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd said it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to manufacture and market Clonazepam tablets.
This is the first generic version of this product, an equivalent of Roche's Klonopin, indicated for the treatment of seizure disorders. Klonopin has annual U.S. sales of about $300 million.
Teva expects to begin shipment of this product shortly.
"This is the largest product for which was have received the first, and to the best of our knowledge, the only generic approval," said William Fletcher, president of Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.
Teva, Israel's largest drug company, also trades on the Nasdaq.
